metadata.name: 14. Shared candidates
metadata.description: One candidate can implement several tasks. When it is chosen for more than one, a feature declared DIVIDE is split between them, because they are paying for one thing rather than for one each. Here 'shared' can serve all three tasks and costs 12; picking it for the first two costs 6 each, which beats the 7 a dedicated candidate would cost. SAME_CANDIDATE puts those two on one candidate and DIFFERENT_CANDIDATE keeps the third off it, so the best binding is shared, shared, only_t3 at a cost of 16.

features.name: Cost
features.description: Paid once for the candidate, split between the tasks that share it.

features.name: Latency
features.description: Spent on every invocation, so sharing does not make it cheaper.

candidates.name: One deployment for any of the three

constraints.description: Tasks 1 and 2 must be served by the very same candidate.
Task 3 must not sit on the same candidate as Task 2.
